brief: Pale concrete stave silo about 16 ft across and 40 ft high, the staves gridded by close-set dark steel hoops, with a column of small round door openings up one side and no roof. It is one of a matched pair standing shoulder to shoulder at the end of a long low gable-roofed dairy barn of weathered boards with a metal roof and rooftop ventilators; a steel windmill, pole corrals, an old disc harrow and dry prairie grass surround them.
